name: Ricardo Alvarez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for racing events he watched on television. He earned a degree in Supply Chain Management and Logistics, initially working in the automotive industry before transitioning to motorsport. He joined Anderson Racing five years ago, quickly establishing himself as a dependable coordinator. 

Ricardo is known for his meticulous approach to logistics, ensuring that every component and piece of equipment arrives at the track on time and in perfect condition. He excels at anticipating potential challenges, such as customs delays or transport disruptions, and proactively developing contingency plans. He is particularly adept at managing the complex international shipping requirements inherent in global racing series. Ricardo's dedication and organizational skills are invaluable to Anderson Racing's competitive performance.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a sturdy build and a friendly, approachable demeanor.
